evidence.database_verification: Initial snapshot shows order 'ORD-1048' exists with internal ID 2 in distribution_orders table. No changes occurred in the database due to failed tool calls.
error_signals: The agent attempted to cancel distribution order ORD-1048 using order_id=1048, but the API expects the internal ID, not the order number
The order_id parameter should be the internal database ID (which is 2 based on the initial snapshot), not the order number (ORD-1048)
last_actions: Attempted to call cancel_distribution_order with order_id=1048
Received 404 error: Distribution order not found
Repeated the same incorrect call multiple times

judge_result.reasoning: The agent attempted to cancel distribution order ORD-1048 but failed because it used the wrong parameter. The tool expected the internal ID (2) instead of the order number (ORD-1048). All attempts resulted in 404 errors indicating the order was not found. No database changes occurred as the tool calls were unsuccessful. The task requires both cancelling the order and releasing inventory, neither of which was completed.

task: Cancel distribution order ORD-1048 for Harbor Pub scheduled for delivery on 2025-04-18 because the account requested a hold, and release the reserved 4 half-barrel kegs of Hazy IPA (lot HZ-2409) back to finished goods inventory at the main brewery.
